Pollution of underground water

DWIVEDI:
SHRI MOTILAL VORA:

been drawn to the report of the School of
Environmental Sciences of Jawaharlal
Nehru University which says that
underground water is getting highly polluted

Mumbai airports

SHRI B.K. HARIPRASAD:
Will the Minister of CIVIL  AVIATION
be pleased to state:

major delays for landings and take-offs at
Delhi and Mumbai airports due to lack of
runway space, etc.;
(b) to what extent Government have
been un-prepared for the expansion of air
traffic;
(c) whether Government will take the
best advise possible to create immediate
inter-mediate arrangements using the
existing runway space;
(d) whether it is a fact that the Airports
Authority of India has not used the latest
methods to arrive at optimum use of existing
runway and parking bay space at Mumbai
and Delhi airports; and
(e) the steps proposed to call in outside
experts to devise new systems for use of
runway space, etc.?

to state:

due to constant neglect of main tourist

easing restrictions on hiring and firing of

examined World Bank's five point

implemented?

cleared?

PETROLEUM AND NATURAL GAS be

commercial vehicles also;

have taken to facilitate supply and
distribution of CNG in the cities of the
country;
(c) whether Government is having any
plan for providing cost effective changes in
the engines; and

Minister of FINANCE be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government's attention has
been drawn to the delay occurring in the
matter of allotting a Permanent Account
Number (PAN);
(b) if so, what steps have been taken by
Government in this regard; and
(c) the number of cities where
computerised system is being used for
allotting a Permanent Account Number
(PAN) at present?
 Review of States’ debt relief schemes

Prime Minister has promised a review of
